name: Squash
description: A research recorder for squash. It streams the wrist sensor's raw 100 Hz motion and your heart rate to files on the watch, and lets you label what you are doing — rally, rest, off court, warm-up, drill, idle — as you play, so the recording arrives already annotated. It writes no activity file and exports nothing: this is the instrument that collects the data a squash metric would be built from, not the metric.

configFields.label: Record raw IMU
configFields.description: Stream the wrist sensor's raw 100 Hz motion to a CSV file, for research. It fills flash fast and stops itself at the caps below, whichever comes first.

configFields.label: Stop after (minutes)
configFields.description: How long one recording may run. A 70-minute match needs more than 70; the default leaves room for a long one.

configFields.label: Stop after (MB)
configFields.description: How large one recording may grow. Motion costs about 4.3 KB a second, so 90 minutes is roughly 22 MB.
